faq.question: Do I need a coding background?
faq.answer: Beginner tracks require no prior experience. Advanced tracks assume Python basics.

faq.question: Are courses self-paced?
faq.answer: Yes — plus live sessions on the Pro plan and cohort-based bootcamps.

faq.question: Do I get a certificate?
faq.answer: Every course grants a verifiable certificate on completion.

faq.question: Can I get a refund?
faq.answer: 7-day no-questions refund on any individual course.

faq.question: Do you offer job placement?
faq.answer: We provide portfolio reviews, referrals and interview prep for Pro members.
